scope: Isolated synthetic DOM/SVG capability experiment; not application acceptance or real-device performance proof
scenarioDefinition: 17 methods, including one baseline, in each of three fresh sequential browser contexts

fixture.normalMap: Constant red=255, green=128 with feDisplacementMap scale=40
fixture.measurement: Real PNG screenshots decoded to RGB; compare a 200 CSS pixel scanline against source baseline offsets from -30 to +30 CSS pixels
fixture.foreground: Ordinary text remains a separate sibling above the decorative glass; RGB changes can include compositor text antialiasing and are not a deformation metric

Parent SVG filter with child backdrop
Parent backdrop with child SVG filter
SVG foreignObject containing native SVG backdrop URL
SVG group filter around foreignObject with native backdrop

alternativeResults.method: feImage reference to ordinary HTML div
feImage reference to HTML already embedded in SVG foreignObject
alternativeResults.limit: Requires restructuring original DOM into SVG; not a compatible replacement for existing native document flow

alternativeResults.method: Direct source filter on SVG foreignObject
alternativeResults.limit: Transforms the complete source rather than sampling the original DOM behind a separate glass surface

controlsAndLimits: Chromium and mobile Chromium blur and invert controls changed the screenshot pixels.

Windows WebKit native blur and invert controls were pixel-inert, including visible 2% white paint, translateZ acceleration, removal of overflow clipping and body background variants. This port cannot establish normal macOS/iOS blur quality.
SVG feImage and direct SVG foreignObject source filtering were positive optical controls in Windows WebKit.
CSS parsing and computed style do not establish actual backdrop refraction.
No tested method preserves the existing native HTML flow, avoids content duplication, and provides arbitrary DOM backdrop displacement across all three tested projects.
No extra WebGL context, runtime dependency or external asset was introduced. All browsers, contexts and the local HTTP server were closed.

localEvidence.publication: Only this compact record is maintained; generated synthetic screenshots remain ignored local QA evidence
